tasks.label: start-android-emulator
tasks.command: EMU=/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools/emulator/emulator; ADB=/opt/homebrew/share/android-commandlinetools/platform-tools/adb; if ! $ADB devices | grep -q 'emulator.*device$'; then nohup $EMU -avd flutter_phone >/dev/null 2>&1 & fi; $ADB wait-for-device; i=0; until [ "$($ADB shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ] || [ $i -ge 90 ]; do sleep 2; i=$((i+1)); done; echo '에뮬레이터 준비 완료'
